requirements.text: Disabled NTUF weapons in all Custom presets become character-default weapons; protect invalid icon rendering.
Keep actors at native or main resolution through every Coast water intermediate.
Remove disabled Bubbles from both newly-created and already-open character selection.
Remove disabled Bubbles from native statistics and hide Frontier statistics.
Gate Undergrowth factories, source population callbacks, weapons and custom area starts.
Optimize enabled-pack weapon queries and avoid unchanged per-frame menu selection rescans; measure native cost.
Suppress authored NTTE/NTUF and native achievement notices for console runs, including after closing console.
Set and restore white text/alpha for authored unlock notifications regardless of prior draw state.
Anchor Robot YES/NO buttons to the same live viewport as the blue background; preserve actual YES/NO callbacks.
Custom mutation selection uses the settings scrollbar, exposes the entire final row and keeps touch hitboxes aligned after scrolling.
